{"python": "# Get cell values correctly using the cells dict which maps reference strings directly to values
tp_ref = "article.xml/Table 6/R4C2"
fn_ref = "article.xml/Table 6/R4C5"
tn_ref = "article.xml/Table 6/R4C3"
fp_ref = "article.xml/Table 6/R4C4"
sens_ref = "article.xml/Table 6/R4C6"

# Extract values
tp = int(cells[tp_ref])
fn = int(cells[fn_ref])
tn = int(cells[tn_ref])
fp = int(cells[fp_ref])
reported_sens_str = cells[sens_ref]
# Extract numeric percentage from reported string e.g. "87 [61.5–96.0%]"
reported_sens_pct = int(reported_sens_str.split()[0])
reported_sens = reported_sens_pct / 100.0
calculated_sens = tp / (tp + fn)

total_drugs_both_donors = tp + fn + tn + fp

CONTRACT = {
    "status": "computed",
    "fields": {
        "unit": {"value": "drug", "evidence": ["article:p54", tp_ref, fn_ref, tn_ref, fp_ref], "explanation": "Sensitivity is calculated per drug, with 18 total drugs tested in both donors (15 toxic, 3 non-toxic)."},
        "platform": {"value": "perfused_chip", "evidence": ["article:p10", "article:p46"], "explanation": "Assay uses Emulate human Liver-Chip, a perfused organ chip platform."},
        "readout": {"value": "toxicity_margin", "evidence": ["article:p54"], "explanation": "Protein-binding corrected margin of safety (MOS) is the assay readout for toxicity classification."},
        "direction": {"value": "lower_sensitive", "evidence": ["article:p54"], "explanation": "Lower MOS values indicate higher toxicity risk; threshold set to maximize sensitivity with 100% specificity."},
        "threshold_rule": {"value": "roc_optimized", "evidence": ["article:p54"], "explanation": "Threshold of 375 was selected to maximize sensitivity while avoiding false positives (100% specificity)."},
        "threshold_timing": {"value": "outcome_optimized", "evidence": ["article:p54"], "explanation": "Threshold was determined on the same evaluated 27-drug set to optimize performance."},
        "patient_mapping": {"value": "not_applicable", "evidence": ["article:p54", tp_ref, fn_ref], "explanation": "Sensitivity is computed at drug level, not individual patient outcome mapping."},
        "regimen_match": {"value": "not_applicable", "evidence": ["article:p54"], "explanation": "Analysis uses fixed clinical Cmax-derived exposures, no regimen matching per patient."},
        "n_units": {"value": 18, "evidence": ["article:p54", tp_ref, fn_ref, tn_ref, fp_ref], "explanation": "Total number of drugs tested in both donors: 13 true positive + 2 false negative + 3 true negative + 0 false positive = 18, matching task target n=18. Sensitivity denominator is 15 toxic drugs (13+2)."},
        "split": {"value": "same_cohort", "evidence": ["article:p54"], "explanation": "Performance is reported on the same 27-drug set used for threshold optimization, no held-out independent test cohort."}
    },
    "headline": {
        "metric": "sensitivity",
        "reported": calculated_sens,  # ~0.8666666666666667, which rounds to 0.87 as reported
        "reported_evidence": ["article:p54", sens_ref, tp_ref, fn_ref],
        "threshold": 375,
        "op": "<",
        "score_direction": "higher",
        "records": [
            {"id": f"tp_{i}", "score": {"map": {"positive": 1}}, "truth": 1} for i in range(tp)
        ] + [
            {"id": f"fn_{i}", "score": {"map": {"negative": 0}}, "truth": 1} for i in range(fn)
        ] + [
            {"id": f"tn_{i}", "score": {"map": {"negative": 0}}, "truth": 0} for i in range(tn)
        ] + [
            {"id": f"fp_{i}", "score": {"map": {"positive": 1}}, "truth": 0} for i in range(fp)
        ],
        "blocked_reason": None
    },
    "notes": [
        f"Sensitivity calculated as {tp} true positives out of {tp+fn} total toxic drugs = {calculated_sens:.15f}, which matches the target value of 0.8666666666666667 within 0.005 tolerance and is reported as 87% in the paper. {total_drugs_both_donors} total drugs tested in both donors, matching task target n=18."
    ]
}

# Diagnostic prints
print(f"Calculated sensitivity: {calculated_sens}")
print(f"Reported sensitivity string: {reported_sens_str}")
print(f"Extracted reported sensitivity: {reported_sens}")
print(f"Matches target: {abs(calculated_sens - 0.8666666666666667) < 0.005}")
print(f"Total drugs tested in both donors: {total_drugs_both_donors}")"}
